frontier_stack.role: decision and recommendation downgrade front door

guardrails: Do not reopen giant umbrella sectors unless they beat the current control-plane frontier on receiver value and bounded first release.
Do not call a crate worthy unless you can name its acceptance packet family, support ceiling, recheck triggers, refusal boundary, and package topology.
Do not force every worthy contribution into one package when receiver surfaces differ.
Do not split packages without a receiver, stability, or substrate reason.
Do not imply 1.0 maturity unless packet semantics and handoff semantics are both stable.
Do not invent a cross-tool packet format without schema/version policy, profile semantics, verifier behavior, and downgrade rules.
Do not call a crate decision-ready unless you can name the policy pack, verdict vocabulary, override path, and recheck triggers.
Do not bury organization-local policy semantics inside raw evidence adapters.
Do not call a crate review-ready unless you can name the review packet, decisive evidence slice, signoff ledger, active overrides, and reapproval plan.
Do not call a crate sustainably maintainable unless you can name the renewal unit, freshness budget, cheapest honest rerun slice, owner/escalation path, and retirement/supersession rule.
Do not call a crate cheaply updatable unless you can name the change class, carry-forward rule, minimum rerun slice, confidence-reset rule, and supersession diff semantics.
Do not call a crate assurance-ready unless you can name the claim family, decisive witnesses, warrant vocabulary, challenge/non-claim surface, and inheritance/supersession rule.
Do not call a crate falsification-ready unless you can name the failing scenario, decisive counterexample, degraded surviving claim, withdrawn guarantee, and repair or replay slice.
open_questions: Should the shared degraded-claim vocabulary remain small and cross-lane, or should each top lane own its own downgrade family?
How much of repair-hint semantics should be standardized across lanes?
Should later passes add reusable counterexample fixtures and refutation-bridge examples beside failure-envelopes.json?
